summary: Hawarden radar service limited to pre-booked instrument flights only between 1600 and 2100 due to staff shortage; other traffic follows radio mandatory zone rules.
text:
HAWARDEN RADAR SER WILL BE AVBL FOR PRE BOOKED IFR TFC ONLY DUE 
STAFF SHORTAGE. FOR ALL OTHER TFC HAWARDEN RADIO MANDATORY ZONE 
CRITERIA APPLY. HAWARDEN RADAR CH120.055 WILL BE BAND-BOXED WITH 
HAWARDEN TWR PROVIDING A BASIC SER ONLY.
